figures.method_workflow: Vector diagram of the implemented method; no numerical results.
figures.stationary_response: Labelled schematic: E=0.5*x^2-0.5*y^2+0.5*R^2+0.45*R*x; local elimination gives Erelaxed=0.5*(1-0.45^2)*R^2. Not molecular data.
figures.vertical_validation: All 19 recorded energies; four prospective errors and MAEs; exact molecule identities from JSON.
figures.molecular_minima: Archived optimized XYZ geometries; rigid principal-axis display rotation and tilt; distance-inferred bonds, no bond-order assignment. Frequencies from SUMMARY.json.
figures.hessian_validation: Archived two-step HVP checks and all-column Hessian discrepancies; no new derivative evaluations.
figures.solver_acceleration: Measured identical-checkpoint 510-rotation orbital Jacobian; excludes preparation and nuclear derivatives; no end-to-end TDA comparison.

publication_extension.scope: 19 curated states, not the new blind set
publication_extension.assignment: cross-AO transition identity with explicit norm/overlap/margin gates
